conjectures.title: Proportional Layer Sweet Spot Holds at 0.6B Scale
conjectures.claim: Optimal style steering layers are 14-20 (50-71% depth), matching proportional range from 7B literature

conjectures.title: Alpha Coherence Threshold Is Lower at 0.6B Than at 7B
conjectures.claim: Coherence collapse onset at alpha >= 0.30, safe range 0.20-0.25 (vs 0.35 at 7B)

conjectures.title: Early Layers (0-7) Produce Topic Drift Not Style Shift
conjectures.claim: Steering at layers 0-7 disrupts semantics (topic drift, language-switching) without producing intended style

conjectures.title: Corpus Mean Vectors Tolerate Higher Alpha Than Contrastive Pairs
conjectures.claim: Corpus-mean vectors (Konen 2024 method) maintain coherence at >= 1.3x the alpha of single contrastive pair vectors

conjectures.title: Multi-Layer Injection at Reduced Per-Layer Alpha Outperforms Single-Layer
conjectures.claim: Two layers at alpha=0.10 each produce stronger style shift with better coherence than one layer at alpha=0.20

conjectures.title: Style Axes Are Non-Orthogonal at 0.6B Scale

evidence.note: formal/socratic/dry-wit cluster at cos_sim>0.95; terse anti-correlated at ~-0.70. Extreme superposition.

conjectures.claim: 4 ActAdd style vectors have mean |cos_sim| > 0.15, with terse-formal more correlated than terse-socratic

conjectures.title: Corpus-Mean and ActAdd Terse Vectors Are Co-Directional but Not Identical
conjectures.claim: Cosine similarity between corpus-mean and ActAdd terse vectors falls in (0.30, 0.80), corpus-mean more stable across layers

conjectures.title: Style Vectors Occupy a Low-Dimensional Subspace (Rank < 3)
conjectures.claim: PCA on 4x1024 style vector matrix: first 3 PCs explain >90% variance

conjectures.title: PTS Thinking Vectors Are Geometrically Distinct from Style Vectors
conjectures.claim: PTS thinking vectors have |cos_sim| < 0.20 with all style axes, <15% projection onto style subspace

conjectures.title: Cross-Axis Interference Under Composition Is Asymmetric and Layer-Dependent
conjectures.claim: Same-layer terse+socratic injection produces more interference than different-layer; terse dominates at same layer

conjectures.title: Weak Refusal Direction in Distilled 0.6B
conjectures.claim: Refusal probe accuracy < 0.80 (vs >0.95 in RLHF'd 7B) due to distillation compressing safety into diffuse subspace

conjectures.title: Style Vectors Orthogonal to Refusal Direction
conjectures.claim: |cos_sim| < 0.10 between all style vectors and refusal direction; terse may be highest at 0.10-0.14

conjectures.title: Safe-Alpha Steering Does Not Degrade Refusal Rate
conjectures.claim: At alpha <= 0.25, refusal rate delta < 5pp from baseline; at alpha > 0.35, delta > 15pp

conjectures.title: Multi-Layer Injection Distributes Rather Than Concentrates Safety Risk
conjectures.claim: 2x0.10 across layers shows >= 5pp less refusal degradation than 1x0.20 at single layer, at total alpha >= 0.30

conjectures.title: Projecting Out Refusal Direction Preserves Style Effect
conjectures.claim: Gram-Schmidt projection removes refusal component; style retention >= 85%, refusal rate within 1pp of baseline at alpha=0.35

conjectures.title: Token-Count Compression as Terse Proxy
conjectures.claim: Terse-steered outputs have >= 40% fewer tokens than baseline across 20 prompts, with min 10 tokens per output

conjectures.title: Perplexity Increases Monotonically with Alpha, Inflection at 0.25-0.35
conjectures.claim: Cross-entropy under unsteered model increases monotonically; slope doubles between alpha=0.25 and alpha=0.35

conjectures.title: Self-Classification Accuracy > 75% (Predicted: Fails at 0.6B)
conjectures.claim: 0.6B model classifying own output as TERSE/VERBOSE achieves > 75% accuracy; predicted to fail at ~0.60-0.70

conjectures.title: Lexical Proxy Features Separate Steered vs Unsteered (AUROC > 0.85)
conjectures.claim: Sentence length, hedging frequency, punctuation density discriminate steered vs baseline; mean_sentence_length alone AUROC ~0.90

conjectures.title: Representation Cosine Similarity Decreases Linearly with Alpha
conjectures.claim: Final-layer cos_sim vs baseline decreases linearly (R^2 > 0.95); slope differs across style axes (terse steepest)

conjectures.title: Superposition Density Threshold
conjectures.claim: At d_model=1024, effective rank < 200 at mid-layers causes steering vectors to collide with 30%+ of top principal components

conjectures.title: Distillation Creates Anisotropic Activation Geometry
conjectures.claim: Distilled 0.6B has top-10 PCs explaining >60% variance vs <45% for from-scratch models

conjectures.title: GQA KV-Head Sharing Compresses Style Subspaces
conjectures.claim: 8 shared KV heads compress style into fewer attention subspaces; attention-head steering 2x coarser than MHA models

conjectures.title: Narrow-But-Deep: Multi-Layer Advantage Larger at 0.6B
conjectures.claim: Multi-layer injection (4+ layers, low alpha each) outperforms single-layer by >= 1.5x at 0.6B, more than at 7B

conjectures.title: Minimum Effective d_model for Contrastive Steering
conjectures.claim: d_model=1024 is near practical boundary for ActAdd: SNR < 4.0, only binary style shifts, not graded control

conjectures.hypothesis: Layer 10 is optimal for 'terse' steering at α=0.2 on Qwen3-0.6B
